explanation: Related to erdosproblems.com/745 (the ≪ log n claim, KSS80). For fixed λ > 1 and any A > 1/(λ − 1 − log λ), the second-largest component of G(n, λ/n) is ≤ A·log n with probability → 1. That is the standard supercritical result (L₂/log n → 1/I_λ with I_λ = λ − 1 − log λ). The edge probability is clipped to [0,1], which matters only for small n. Faithful.
